additional_info.subject: RE: ID0441321-DC/Si-D/AT- [MP / S2 170003381] Issue with charging process CRM:02684000456
additional_info.body:
Good evening Mr. Cenoiu,
I am reaching out from the Expert Services Team in regards of ticket
ID0441321
. The ticket has been opened for a charging session with MeterStart=MeterStop values, happened on 18.07.2025 on charger
MP/S2 170003381
.
This incorrect behavior is caused by an invalid OCMF record. Our R&D department has already addressed the topic, and the fix will be included in the upcoming FW version
v8.1.X.
As soon as the FW v8.1.X will be released (current exp. date CW39 2025), the colleagues from Siemens Austria will reach out to you and inform you about the update.
Since there is no pending action form service side, and the fix for this issue is planned, I will proceed to close the ticket.
Thank you again for raising the issue and for reaching out to us!
With kind regards,
